  "note": "Chosen entity: Atoll Holdco Ltd., the Cayman Islands private company (Companies House overseas company FC040033, UK establishment BR025143). It is the top holding company (\"Topco\") of the Ocean Outdoor group. The Atairos-led takeover of Ocean Outdoor Limited (formerly listed in London) completed around 2022-06-14 (source: ADVFN/Investors Hub news list, 'Ocean Outdoor takeover by Atairos Group takes full effect', June 14 2022). That is outside the three-year window before 2026-06-18, so no events are listed. Atoll Holdco's own shares were never listed; the merger circular describes its securities as unlisted. Caveats: (1) The subsidiary and parent answer is based on 2022 deal documents (Atoll Bidco described as a wholly-owned indirect subsidiary of Atairos Group, Inc.) and a 2024 statement that Atairos is Ocean's majority owner. I found no 2026 source confirming Atairos' exact stake in Atoll Holdco itself, and rollover holders and Ares entities also hold Topco shares. (2) Atairos' unlisted status rests on it being described as a private investment company; I found no register entry for it. (3) I found no evidence either way on listed debt, so it is unknown. (4) Companies House and aggregator pages were checked as current snapshots, not as sources dated exactly 2026-06-18."
